homeContent.subtitle: AKA Home · Official Repository
homeContent.heroDescription: The Department of Education, AKA Home is an independent educational administration dedicated to academic governance, institutional standards, curriculum coordination, and administrative integrity. This portal serves as the centralized repository for all official notifications, administrative circulars, executive orders, and institutional communications.
homeContent.welcomeText: All documents published in this repository are maintained by the administrative office of Department of Education, AKA Home. For clarification on published records or inquiries, navigate to the Contact section.

aboutContent.heading: About Department of Education, AKA Home
aboutContent.subtitle: Governance, Standards, and Institutional Integrity
aboutContent.description: The Department of Education, AKA Home operates as an independent educational administration overseeing administrative coordination, curriculum guidance, official circular distribution, and institutional directives.
aboutContent.mission: To foster educational excellence, institutional transparency, and administrative rigor through clear public notices, verified circulars, and disciplined governance standards.
aboutContent.vision: A modern, accessible, and accountable institutional framework providing equitable educational oversight and reliable repository access for students, educators, and administrators.

coreValues.title: Transparency
coreValues.description: Immediate public access to all circulars, notifications, and administrative determinations.

coreValues.title: Academic Integrity
coreValues.description: Upholding rigorous pedagogical standards and institutional compliance across all programs.

coreValues.title: Accountability
coreValues.description: Systematic record-keeping and verifiable executive orders published in digital repository format.

coreValues.title: Accessibility
coreValues.description: Universal access to public documentation with clear classification and responsive support.

keyResponsibilities: Issuing regulatory circulars and advisory memoranda.
Publishing official notifications and public announcements.
Executing institutional orders and administrative directives.
Maintaining verifiable public document records and archival repositories.
Addressing public correspondence and institutional inquiries.
